fusions.name: Mace of Office
fusions.desc: A blow from the rod that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Gauntlet
fusions.desc: Throws down a gauntlet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Household Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds. A guardsman fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Phalanx Oath
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a ward absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
